// About Relastra

The command center
built for authors who ship.

Relastra is a desktop-first release and event planning tool built specifically for indie authors managing multiple titles, series, and publishing deadlines at the same time. It replaces the chaos of spreadsheets, sticky notes, and fractured calendars with a single visual system that shows you exactly where every book stands — from first draft to published.

Unlike SaaS tools that charge monthly and store your data on someone else's server, Relastra is a one-time purchase that runs entirely on your machine. Your catalog, your strategy, your publishing schedule — all of it lives locally, under your control, with no internet connection required after install.

Built for the author who publishes at speed, tracks multiple series across pen names, and needs a tool that can actually keep up.

📅Visual release calendar with status tracking
📚Series management with color-coded labels
🔒100% local — no account, no cloud, no subscription
🖥️Native desktop app for Windows & Mac
// Built by Someone Who Uses It

The author who built this

I'm Raven DeNoir — BWWM dark romance author, full-time remote employee, mother, and the developer behind Storyline Systems. I started publishing in May 2025 and never stopped.

I didn't build Relastra because I thought it would make a great product. I built it because nothing existed that could keep up with how fast I publish. I was managing 60+ titles across multiple series out of spreadsheets and memory — tracking release windows, series order, launch status, and what was coming next across more books than any single tool was designed to handle.

So I built the tool I needed. Then I decided other authors deserved the same.

"I needed something that could keep up with how fast I publish. Nothing existed. So I built it — and then I couldn't stop using it. That's when I knew other authors needed it too."
